title: SpaceX 拟购困境初创数据 用于AI模型
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Some breaking news on the Bloomberg terminal, Elon Musk's SpaceX has held internal discussions about buying customer and operational information data from troubled or defunct start-ups according
segments.zh: 彭博终端突发消息，马斯克的SpaceX内部讨论过从陷入困境或已停运的初创公司购买客户和运营数据。

segments.en: to sources. It's targeting a more affordable data source to improve its AI models. The people said the talks within teams in the SpaceX AI are informal and may not result in deals.
segments.zh: 据知情人士称，此举旨在获取更实惠的数据源以改进其AI模型。这些讨论在SpaceX AI团队内部是非正式的，可能不会达成交易。
